description: Shared cases for both clients: a sanitised file name loses control, format and default-ignorable characters, keeps at most 255 bytes of UTF-8 and keeps its extension only when the extension is at most 16 bytes, and loses the dots and spaces a cut leaves at its end. A name is its parts joined, each part a text repeated count times.

cases.name: an astral extension longer than 16 bytes is cut with the stem
an astral extension of 16 bytes is kept
an ASCII extension of 16 bytes is kept
an ASCII extension of 17 bytes is cut with the stem
a two-byte extension within 16 bytes is kept
a two-byte extension longer than 16 bytes is cut with the stem
the stem is cut at a whole character
only the last extension is kept
a three-byte stem is cut at a whole character
a cut that ends in a dot and a space loses both
a name of 255 bytes stays whole
variation selectors and other default-ignorable characters disappear
Hangul fillers, unassigned ignorable code points and tag characters disappear
bidi controls cannot reorder the extension
